scientific_integrity: The coefficient is derived analytically from the independent chi-square representation, exact F moments, normalized chi-square central moments, and a Taylor expansion with exponentially small tail control. The bundled computation is only a regression check. Prior results are used only for comparison and the limiting benchmark.
scientific_limitations: Pointwise large-denominator asymptotic for each fixed integer numerator degree at least 6. No uniform threshold, full denominator-degree monotonicity, entire finite range m>=5, or joint two-degree asymptotic is claimed.
title: Positive first-order endpoint margin in the F-variation problem
